method.starting_point: README.md, then AGENTS.md/product boundary, review route and linked implementation/evidence
method.scope: Declared fictional hackathon prototype, with deterministic R0-R18 core and separately measured voice/reviewer extensions; production and optional fleet completion are separate scopes.

dimensions.name: Technical judgment
dimensions.justification: The pure ordered R0-R18 motor emits reads/waits rather than write capability. Trusted bindings, owned selection, query isolation, explicit consent, signed admission, fresh risk/ownership checks, attempted markers, independent receipt readback, revocation and conservative recovery form a coherent implemented lifecycle. Contract-derived acceptance uses the real runtime/store. My 1,078-check replay passed unchanged source. Residual risk is broader semantic/provider-path qualification, not an absent deterministic core.

dimensions.name: AI engineering
dimensions.justification: Executable interpretation stages, bounded schemas, grounding guards, repair/fallback, provider/native interfaces, integrated speech with exact playback acknowledgments and durable inquiries are substantial. The recorded two reviewers are actual parallel provider calls, each selecting an enum recommendation; trusted facts/copy supply their displayed prose. Saved speech and return visits are evidenced. This is a useful bounded team, not demonstrated open-ended investigation. Native speech can omit a canonical caveat, independent human audio review is pending, and fleet customer acceptance failed before delegation.

dimensions.name: Data engineering
dimensions.justification: Six-table bronze/silver/gold work includes contracts, quarantine, deterministic deduplication, lineage, ownership validation, isolated immutable builds, a writer lock and atomic CURRENT publication after complete gold/manifest production. Public fixtures demonstrate reconciliation, rerun identity, owner exclusion, late correction/new rows and retention of prior snapshots. Full historical 5,899,720-row statistics remain private-source aggregates, not recomputed data. Bronze inventory assumes static objects rather than VersionId-pinned ingestion, and crash durability beyond atomic replacement is not established.

dimensions.name: ML/evaluation
dimensions.justification: The team detects template leakage/unlearnable weak labels rather than reporting misleading organizer-data ML success. The fixed 120-case ES/PT diagnostic compares keywords, TF-IDF/logistic and abstention, with preselected parameters, hashes, uncertainty and safety/escalation metrics. However all labels are AI-authored, human adjudication remains pending and no production generalization follows. My independent Luna audit confirms 100 exact/safe completions and its independent deterministic baseline tie; ten repeated phrase types make it a load/grounding diagnostic, not 100 diverse interpretations or an LLM quality advantage.

dimensions.name: Data analytics
dimensions.justification: Metadata-only read-only extraction, HMAC identities, workflow/transcript denominators, stage latency, retry/error/grounding flags and feedback are implemented and public fixtures pass privacy/source-integrity checks. Operating analysis connects actual ownership/leakage discoveries and router escalation burdens to product decisions, separates queueing from voice latency, and reports token/cache overhead without inventing dollar savings. Customer usefulness is still n=3 across revisions plus a separate n=1 post-fix observation; cost, repeat-contact effects and live human outcomes are unmeasured. Containment means absence of handoff, not verified dispute resolution.

dimensions.name: Architecture/extensibility
dimensions.justification: The byte-verified pinned subset exposes genuinely generic OpenAI-style chat/direct/flow dispatch, FlowSpec compile/validate/save, typed runFlow input/result, model adapters, MCP transports and a trusted execution-extension contract. Domain authority remains in Savia/MCP. A release-note digest is a concrete non-banking example. The examples are illustrative and important implementation imports remain outside the review subset.

dimensions.name: Execution/integration
dimensions.justification: Source implements durable/ephemeral runs, continuation, immutable snapshots, explicit invocation sources, approval policy, events, cancellation ancestry and MCP visibility/progress/timeout handling. A dated aggregate reports a real FLUJO 300-request workload and separate sandbox/tool exercises. These are substantive evidence at their own revisions, but raw infrastructure histories remain private and are not current-public-pin transport/model interoperability receipts.

dimensions.name: Safety/recovery
dimensions.justification: Inspectable checkpoints track effects and refuse automatic replay for unknown effects; Persona durable mutations require current lock-capable authority; conversation locking is reentrant and serialized within a process. Generic approvals are explicitly configurable rather than bank consent. Recovery depends on truthful tool annotations, ordinary runs default to no approval, and this packet does not establish cross-process conversation ownership or crash/endurance behavior.

dimensions.name: Reproducible engineering
dimensions.justification: All 39 copied source files and 619,009 bytes independently match declared SHA-256/Git blobs. My five dependency-free retry/cancellation checks pass. The repository supplies per-test receipts/logs for 104 upstream tests across nine suites and discloses mocks and eleven installed-package mismatches. It is not a full buildable distribution, and I did not reproduce that broader suite, clean locked install, production build or full platform tests within the allowed repository-only scope.

dimensions.name: Developer usability
dimensions.justification: The new platform guide maps each interface to local exact source and immutable public URLs, provides ordinary integration payloads and explains authority, approvals and reproduction limits clearly. Source review is easy here. A developer still needs the complete pinned FLUJO checkout/catalogs and matching dependencies to run examples or build; the copy is intentionally incomplete.

The review route reports consequential ownership/template defects rather than assuming FK existence or row-level holdout proves quality; later implementation/fixtures support its response to them.
Generic FLUJO now has an inspectable pinned 39-file source packet and 104 scoped upstream tests, with explicit incompleteness, mocks and dependency drift.
Policy source contains actual ordered R0-R18 decisions; host confirmation is a wait/status-read boundary, and attempted actions remain recoverable without another write.
The customer success receipt evidences two genuine bounded model reviewers, useful saved facts/advice and helpful closure, while preserving direct-provider scope and changed UI capture provenance.

prioritized_improvements: Complete independent bilingual human adjudication while preserving frozen labels/receipts; use a new untouched set for subsequent tuning.
Guarantee critical action/outcome qualifiers in native speech, or use exact trusted TTS for protected result messages; add independent human listening/accessibility review.
Persist stage token/cache/cost observations with source/provider/time identity and join trusted host receipts into final case outcomes; keep no-handoff separate from completed resolution.
Publish one concise current-source lifecycle acceptance matrix linking each R0-R18 boundary to source checks and dated native/API/customer proof, without replacing historical pins.
For a reusable FLUJO release, run a clean pinned dependency build and generic transport/recovery examples; separately measure cross-process conversation ownership and crash recovery.
Qualify the expanded fleet only when that optional extension becomes a requested deliverable; retain failed root correlation and independent-result checks.
